WITH
cirrhosis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 4064161
  UNION SELECT 4064161
),
outpt AS (
  SELECT 9202 AS concept_id UNION ALL SELECT 5084 UNION ALL SELECT 8756 UNION ALL SELECT 8947 UNION ALL SELECT 581380 UNION ALL SELECT 38004207 UNION ALL SELECT 38004208 UNION ALL SELECT 38004209 UNION ALL SELECT 38004234 UNION ALL SELECT 38004235 UNION ALL SELECT 38004236 UNION ALL SELECT 38004237
),
idx AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN cirrhosis cc ON cc.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence v ON v.visit_occurrence_id = co.visit_occurrence_id
  JOIN outpt o ON o.concept_id = v.visit_concept_id
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
elig AS (
  SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date
  FROM idx i
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id
    AND op.observation_period_start_date <= i.index_date
    AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day,365,i.index_date)
),
nsbb_ingredients AS (
  SELECT 1353766 AS ingredient_id UNION ALL SELECT 1313200 UNION ALL SELECT 1346823 UNION ALL SELECT 902427
),
nsbb_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN nsbb_ingredients ni ON ni.ingredient_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE c.domain_id='Drug'
    AND LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%oral%'

    AND LOWER(c.concept_name) NOT LIKE '%injection%'
